text: Senate Study Bill 3045 - Introduced SENATE FILE _____ BY (PROPOSED COMMITTEE ON STATE GOVERNMENT BILL BY CHAIRPERSON ROZENBOOM) A BILL FOR An Act relating to the verification of United States 1 citizenship of persons registering to vote. 2 BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF IOWA: 3 TLSB 5635XC (1) 91 ss/ns S.F. _____ Section 1. NEW SECTION . 48A.33A Verification of 1 citizenship. 2 Prior to registering a registrant to vote, the registrar 3 shall attempt to verify the registrant’s United States 4 citizenship using the systematic alien verification for 5 entitlements system of the United States citizenship and 6 immigration services. The registrar shall not register the 7 registrant to vote if the registrar is unable to verify the 8 United States citizenship of the registrant. The registrant 9 may appeal the registrar’s decision to the district court in 10 the registrar’s county, and the decision of the court shall be 11 final. 12 EXPLANATION 13 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 14 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 15 This bill requires a county commissioner of registration 16 (registrar) to verify the U.S. citizenship of a person using 17 the systematic alien verification for entitlements system 18 of the U.S. citizenship and immigration services prior to 19 registering the person to vote. The bill prohibits a registrar 20 from registering a person to vote if the registrar is unable 21 to verify the U.S. citizenship of the person. The bill allows 22 a person to appeal the decision of a registrar to the district 23 court in the registrar’s county, and the decision of the court 24 shall be final. 25 -1- LSB 5635XC (1) 91 ss/ns 1/ 1
